title: Separate observe, prepare, and execute tool classes
narrative: Read-only observers must not invoke mutating tools; preparation returns typed proposals; execution alone gates mutating calls. A tool alias must not bypass an observer restriction. Lifecycle observe hooks exist (`fangore_insp_lifecycle_observe`) but are not a tool-class taxonomy. Tracks MH-DOTS-03[^insp-dots-03].
implementation: Adjacent: EffectKind / OBSERVE reconcile, ObserveBefore/After lifecycle, flat Tool + grants. Desired: Observe / Prepare / Execute tool classes with enforcement that consequential work only runs in Execute.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-DOTS-03, coverage gap, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
